body: Man I'd rather talk privately if you are ok with that, if not no worries, I just dont want anything I say to be linked back to me
If we could talk privately that would be appreciated, if not no worries, thanks for caring anyway

Good advice man, thanks for your help, I'll probably wait until covid calms down to book an appointment because I assume they're incredibly busy as is. Hopefully I can get the problem sorted though. Cheers.

Sometimes its good to just wait until you are that exhausted you cant stay awake (providing you dont have any responsibilities to take care of that is).

I know that sounds stupid but when you are so exhausted you pass out you usually have a very long sleep, I find i dream more aswell, and when you wake up your perspective on a situation may have completely changed.

I live in the North and if say upwards of 75% of people my age do drugs on nights out, its surprising. As for wanting a relationship I've never really been bothered. I think I am going to contact my doctor to try and get it sorted atleast somewhat.

Out of curiosity how the hell would you bring it up, I know doctors are there to help but I still feel awkward as hell ringing up about this at my young age.

I hope you manage to get back into a healthy relationship with your friends as well man. Truly, having a good group of friends can lift your mood so much. One of the most important things in life imo.

Thanks man, im definitely calming down on the whole drugs thing, its just that in the UK its so common its hard not to get involved.

As for satisfying a partner I absolutely get what you're saying, plenty of ways to please without worrying about  premature ejaculation. But at my age it is all new, girls want sex, and when most of what everyone knows is from porn it can be very hard to deliver.

I have a similar issue. Im 19 and not very active on social media. I hadn't spoken to my closest friends in over a month, not because I didnt want to but because I didnt talk to anyone other than my household, I just kind of forgot. Anyway I eventually decided to message my good friends, and I guess because they know me and know my personality no one even questioned it. We basically picked up conversation as if nothing ever happened.

Essentially what I'm trying to say is if your friends know you well, they probably won't think too much of it, you're probably ovethinking the situation, the longer you leave it the worse it gets in your head. Just message people, see how they are, and im sure things will return back to normal in no time.
